## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

- [ ] Performance enhancement

## Key Verification Points
- [ ] All conversions run 100% in-browser with zero external network requests.
- [ ] Tested across modern desktop and mobile browsers.
- [ ] Memory leaks checked (Object URLs are properly revoked).
- [ ] Unit tests pass via `node tests/converter.test.js`.
- [ ] Branded under SPManchester Private Limited guidelines.
